title: CRM
subtitle: Customer relationships: who to call today, what the portfolio is worth, and what was last said. Every figure is computed from recorded events.

mrr.label: MRR
mrr.unknown: Plan prices are not set on the server, so revenue cannot be calculated yet.

pipeline.note: Cards drag between stages; on a touch screen the dropdown on the card is the reliable route. Stage is the only field a person sets — the lifecycle (lead, trial, subscriber, lapsed) is read off the real subscription.

engagement.hint: Activity indicator from the recorded events of the last {{days}} days
engagement.title: Engagement
engagement.subtitle: From the recorded events of the last {{days}} days. Not a prediction — the rows below account for the whole of it.

deleteDialog.title: Delete this lead for good?
deleteDialog.body: The lead and its notes and tasks are removed. This cannot be undone.

notes.title: Notes
notes.subtitle: What you write down after a call is what survives six weeks later. The kind is a separate field because a phone call and a decision are not the same thing.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.subtitle: What happened: what the company did, what we granted them, how their profile changed, and what we wrote down.

access.title: Access
access.note: No payment gateway is connected yet — access is granted here, and every grant is logged.

profile.title: Company profile
profile.empty: No company profile filled in yet — which is itself a reason to call.

saved.title: Saved calls
saved.subtitle: What this company set aside — the best guide there is to what to talk about.

leads.intro: Visitors who completed the free assessment and asked to be contacted. Their answers and readiness score are from the submission they actually made, so the first call does not start from a blank page.
leads.emptyHint: The free assessment offers a follow-up at the end; what is entered there arrives here.

mrr.label: MRR
mrr.sub: The 30-day value of subscriptions that are active right now

kpi.unknown: Plan prices are not set on the server, so revenue cannot be calculated yet.

insights.noPlans: No paid subscription is active yet.

trend.title: New contacts by month
trend.subtitle: From the real timestamps of sign-ups and leads, over the last six months. An empty month is shown too, because that is information as well.

warm.title: Active, but not yet subscribed
warm.subtitle: Accounts that used the product in the last {{days}} days but have no subscription. This is the most useful call order there is, because it rests on things that actually happened.
warm.empty: No account is in that position right now.
